name: TARS-Agent zero-model deterministic runtime evidence
description: Twelve fixed allowlisted pytest runtime cases. No LLM or arbitrary manifest command is executed.

tasks.goal: Verify normal workspace-sandbox write and read behavior.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: pytest tmp_path is released after the case process exits

tasks.goal: Verify absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: no path outside the temporary workspace is created

tasks.goal: Verify symlink and junction escape is rejected where the platform supports it.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: external target remains untouched and pytest tmp_path is released

tasks.goal: Verify wrong-session and invalid permission decisions cannot resolve a request.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: pending permission task is resolved only by the valid scoped decision

tasks.goal: Verify unavailable sandbox fails closed and starts no host process.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: host runtime request list remains empty

tasks.goal: Verify required sandbox policy cannot fall back to the host.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: no host process starts when required sandbox is unavailable

tasks.goal: Verify a timed-out Bash invocation cannot leave a child process that writes a delayed marker.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: timed-out bash child cannot write a delayed marker and run cleanup is recorded

tasks.goal: Verify duplicate client_message_id submissions reuse one durable run.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: runtime service closes and the single run reaches a terminal state

tasks.goal: Verify restart recovery marks interrupted daemon runs terminal.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: hard-killed daemon is reaped and restarted run is marked interrupted without replay

tasks.goal: Verify daemon shutdown cancels and persists all background subagents.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: hard-killed daemon and active subagent are reaped and not resumed after restart

tasks.goal: Verify manual compaction commits context and audit evidence transactionally.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: runtime service and persistence resources close after the transaction

tasks.goal: Verify unsupported binary MCP content is omitted from model context.
tasks.cleanup_assertion: fake MCP client contains no pending transport work
